text:
people-ops: Drafting a tiny 'support-checkcard' micro-template for goal notes used in perf cycle reviews and skip-levels. Goal: one glance shows impact, evidence, current blocker, and owner. Quick pasteable and manager-actionable. Link to draft: https://redwood.doc/support-checkcards

people-ops: Template (copy/paste):

people-ops: ```
Impact: Reduced daily inference spend by 20% (lower cost/token).
Evidence: Introduced quantization + shared KV cache; cost $/wk  = $320 -> $256.
Blocker: Need a canary rollout plan and staging infra access.
Owner: miguel (eng-infra) | confidence: med
```

ana: Clean and useful. Suggest swap 'Blocker' -> 'Support/Blocker' so ICs can request either help or call out a dependency.

david: Could we add a single-line standup form: `Eng: Reduced spend 20%  quant+cache  Need canary/staging access` for quick updates in skip-level threads?

marta: For manager notes, include a tiny checkbox set for calibration: `[ ] Evidence ok [ ] Impact plausible [ ] Needs follow-up`. Helps in 15-min calibration rounds.

people-ops: Good ideas. We'll: 1) change label to 'Support/Blocker', 2) add single-line paste variant, 3) include reviewer checkboxes, 4) add 3 role-specific examples (eng, product, cs).

people-ops-bot: Reminder: new handbook section "Support-checkcards" scheduled publish 2024-07-15. Announcement will go to #announcements.

ana: I'll pilot the cards with my team next retro and share examples.

david: I can contribute a CS example that maps customer impact to goal metrics.

people-ops: Thanks! We'll update the doc today and ping for a quick thumbs. :sparkles:
